(II)--(Ananta): a तामस form of विष्णु down below the पाताल regions; with

jewelled heads, purple garment, white necklace; in his hands are the plough and mace; worshipped by लक्ष्मी and वारुणी; when the deluge sets in, he vomits venomed fire devouring the three worlds; नाग maids adorn him with fragrant sandal paste; celestials and Asuras worship him; गन्गा worshipped him and learnt from him astronomy and astrology; supports the whole earth with his head;
1: Vi.

(III)--the नाग, King of पातालम्. Follows the वैष्णव policy;
1: Br. II. १७. ३४; २०. ५४-5;
